issues.where: foreground rock ledge at bottom left (also in set-A-01-b.png)
issues.what: the craggy, fractured mineral rock in -a is replaced by a smooth, dimpled, melted-looking mesh with a blurry procedural texture
issues.fix: rebuild the ledge with sharp-edged fractured rock geometry, crisp mineral grit, warm rust staining, and grounded ambient occlusion

issues.where: left brine pool, central winding channel, and pool bubbles
issues.what: the water is flat, matte maroon-brown with uniform ripples, harsh white-painted shorelines, and tiny pale dots instead of the reflective translucent rust-red brine and large pinkish bubble domes in -a
issues.fix: restore translucent rust-red brine shading with overcast sky reflections, fine wind ripples, wet salt-crusted margins, and large translucent reddish bubble domes

issues.where: wading creatures in the central channel and resting creatures on the right salt flat
issues.what: the wading animals look like smooth, blobby segmented lumps and the right-bank creatures look like low-poly pale sculptures with stick legs and an unexplained ribbed dome, lacking wet hide, salt-crust detail, and contact shadows
issues.fix: model realistic wrinkled wading quadrupeds and naturally encrusted bank creatures with fine wet skin or crust texture and grounded water and ground contact shadows

issues.where: salt flats and mud cracks across the right foreground and midground
issues.what: the right foreground shows an artificial, uniform tile-like crack pattern and the midground flats look like smooth white snow instead of layered mineral salt crust
issues.fix: replace with irregular, multi-scale fractured salt-crust geometry, natural brine seepage in the cracks, and varied wet-to-dry mineral shading

issues.where: red-plumed stalks around the pool and midground (also in set-A-01-b.png)
issues.what: the organically curved, salt-crusted stalks with lush feathery crimson crowns in -a become rigid straight sticks with sparse dark tufts and an oversized thick foreground stalk on the far left
issues.fix: give the stalks natural curvature, encrusted bark, denser feathery crimson plumes, and organic clustering around the pool and mounds

issues.where: large bubble dome at right-center and smaller bubbles across the pool
issues.what: the thin, glossy, grit-flecked translucent bubble in -a is rendered as an opaque matte grey-lavender hemisphere with a plastic specular spot, and the foreground foam and small bubbles are missing
issues.fix: shade the bubbles as thin, glossy translucent membranes revealing the reddish brine and suspended grit beneath, and restore the frothy clusters and small bubbles in the lower left

issues.where: brine pool surface and bursting splash (also in set-A-03-b.png)
issues.what: the turbulent, frothy, insect-dotted brine in -a becomes a smooth, glossy procedural shader with smeared reflections, no micro-ripples or insects, and a clunky flat splash crown with oversized dark glassy droplets
issues.fix: add fine multi-scale water turbulence, wet foam, suspended grit, skimming insects, and a thin jagged liquid splash crown with delicate droplets

issues.where: bottom foreground edge and overall depth of field
issues.what: the crusty white-and-rust salt shoreline framing the bottom of -a is missing, and the shallow photographic depth of field is absent, leaving the background sharply cut out
issues.fix: restore the detailed mineral crust ledge along the bottom foreground and match the shallow depth of field that softly blurs both the near foreground and the distant background

issues.where: background wading creature, stalks, far-left foreground stalk, and mist
issues.what: the softly blurred quadruped in -a is replaced by a dark, blocky, indistinct grey silhouette; the stalks are sparse straight sticks with a blurry cylinder at far left; and the rising steam over the left pool is gone
issues.fix: restore accurate quadruped anatomy, denser feathery crimson stalks, realistic encrusted bark on the foreground stalk, and layered steam rising on the left

issues.where: crimson frond plumes on the foreground stalks (also in set-A-05-b.png)
issues.what: the glistening, wet, finely separated red filaments in -a are rendered as flat dark-maroon clumps with hard polygonal cutout edges, no clinging water droplets, and dark stray streaks hanging from the collar
issues.fix: replace with finely resolved individual wet filaments, translucent rim highlights, clinging water droplets, and clean silhouette edges without polygonal clipping

issues.where: foreground stalk shafts, collars, buds, and broken stem at bottom right
issues.what: the encrusted organic stems and frayed hollow tip in -a become smooth segmented cylinders with a blurry repeating grid-like texture, paper-thin jagged collars, smooth shiny acorn-like buds, and a crude low-poly V-notched tip
issues.fix: add irregular flaking salt-crust geometry, organic ridged bark, layered fibrous buds, and a finely frayed hollow broken stem

issues.where: midground pool, wading creature on the right, distant mound, and sky
issues.what: the wading creature is replaced by a featureless dark grey lump, the mineral mound is a flat geometric trapezoid, the water has opaque grey bubbles and lacks steam, the background lacks shallow depth of field, and the distant rain curtains are missing
issues.fix: restore the softly out-of-focus wading quadruped, craggy salt-and-rust mound, translucent bubbling brine with low steam, shallow background blur, and overcast rain curtains

issues.where: distant horizon, sky, and steam over the left pool
issues.what: the continuous hazy mountain ridge and soft rain curtains in -a are replaced by sharp flat-topped geometric mesas and overly straight diagonal streaks in a flat grey sky, while the pool steam looks like a uniform airbrushed puff
issues.fix: replace the mesas with soft, continuous hazy hills, add overcast cloud variation with natural rain shafts, and give the steam wispy, multi-layered vertical structure

issues.where: small insects perched on the fronds and around the stalks (also in set-A-05-b.png)
issues.what: the delicate, translucent-winged insects perched on and hovering near the fronds in -a appear as pale grey spiky or bristled blobs and odd floating shapes in front of the stalks
issues.fix: model delicate winged insects with slender bodies and translucent wings perched naturally on and hovering around the crimson fronds
